findings.motion: Motion 9 To Concur HCS and H Amends (Senate roll call 439); passed 27 to 18
findings.note: Senate roll call on SB 747, Elections Law Changes. Batch is listed among the Noes. The ratified bill text requires photo identification (G.S. 163-166.16) for same-day registration at early voting, adds failure to show photo ID as a ground for challenging a voter at the polls, and keeps photo voter ID card issuance rules. It also makes other changes to election observers, ballot retention and mail-ballot notices.

findings.motion: Motion 11 Veto Override (Senate roll call 482); passed 30 to 19
findings.note: Senate vote to override the Governor's veto of SB 747, Elections Law Changes. Batch is listed among the Noes. The bill includes photo ID requirements for same-day registration and a photo ID challenge ground at the polls.
